sources_note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry; the facts in it are cited to the source named beside it (PowerPyx's GTA 6 trophy guide unless another source is named). Nothing here is copied from those guides.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you earn: it pops the moment the other 54 are done, and there is no separate task behind it. Work the roadmap in order - story first, then the 100% completion checklist, then the cleanup - and it unlocks on its own. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4 out of 10 difficulty and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough and no online trophies.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, impossible to miss. Finish Gone Fishing, the opening mission of Chapter 1, and it pops when the mission ends. This is the first story trophy and the start of the five-chapter story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1: play its missions through to the end and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Story trophies unlock automatically as you finish chapters, so none of them can be missed. Before you leave Chapter 1, do the balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude - that one can be missed.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2: finish its missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up - after the mission Coffee Break you can switch between Jason and Lucia, which most side trophies need.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3: finish its missions and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapter 3 is where several questlines start - Andy (Lucia only), Randy's wish list and Tyrone's labs - so take the optional missions as they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4: finish its missions and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. Chapter 4 holds the optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which unlocks bank vault robberies - do it when it appears, it is the key to Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission of the story and this gold trophy pops. It is automatic and unmissable. Some listings word it as the end of Chapter 5 rather than a separate final mission, but either way it is the last story beat - after it you return to free-roam and the 100% completion checklist unlocks.

sources.name: eGamers - GTA 6 Trophy List (notes the Chapter 5 wording difference)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 story mission. It pops when the mission ends, automatically - story mission trophies cannot be missed, just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 story mission. It pops when the mission ends - automatic and unmissable, like every story mission trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops when the mission ends - automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 story mission. It pops when the mission ends - automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 story mission at the airport. It pops when the mission ends - automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 story mission. It pops when the mission ends - automatic and unmissable.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist unlocks after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, and any progress you made during the story already counts. PowerPyx calls the thresholds lenient - about 60% of true completion: scan 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of the 255 animals through binoculars, complete any 70 of the 80 challenges, and finish every robbery, underwater discovery, shooting range, drone race and Bret quest. Nothing on the checklist is missable and everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Both PowerPyx and KeenGamer rank this the hardest trophy and the bulk of the roughly 200-hour platinum.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute - mix them however you like, and the flights under bridges are the quickest. Track progress by region under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going after this pops.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check them under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities - scrolling over each shows how many you have done. The story introduces most of them and the rest get marked when you unfog the map, so this usually pops on its own while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. PowerPyx lists every range location and reports the gold medals are not too hard. All 42 are also required for the 100% completion checklist, so this is a must-do, not a side goal.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every one of the 14 locations - 42 races in total. PowerPyx lists all 14 locations; you only need one win per location, not every race. All of them are also needed for the 100% checklist.

sources.name: eGamers - GTA 6 Trophy List (42 races across 14 locations)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 unique race locations, and each one only counts once, so you need to win at 20 separate spots rather than repeating your favourite. The 100% checklist wants 30 wins, so keep racing after this pops - PowerPyx lists all 40 locations.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing location marked with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Go there and beat him in the fishing challenge to pop the trophy.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game - called Video Games in-game. There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, all playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you must finish all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge, and it does not matter which of the four you pick.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline, which is Lucia only. It starts in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then she texts you her home address, marking the questline on the map in Belville. Complete all five of her quests - Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and Puff Puff Pass - and the trophy pops on the last one. All of her quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline. It starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him: he calls you, then is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks, marking purple treasure chest icons on the map - dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back to him, and he marks more locations after each set. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees. Kenton goes quiet during Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so the trophy is not missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline. It unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break and is marked at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Complete all five of his quests - Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler, and Hometown Heroes - and the trophy pops on the last one. All of his quests are still available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands. Only certain questlines count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed, while the questlines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy. Watch the trophy tracker in the trophy list for your count, and note that more qualifying strangers are still being discovered. All of them can still be found after the story in free-roam.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List. It unlocks in Chapter 3 during the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, when you steal the Zorrusso with the Key Cloner and deliver it to him. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) - scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on his list, then drive it back to him in good condition for more money. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. This can still be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, which is Jason only. It unlocks after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers appear for the Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and you must destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. After enough labs are destroyed, Tyrone gives you his second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down - the trophy pops when that is done. All of it is still available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Each spot counts twice if both Jason and Lucia meditate there - track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE ONLY POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: during Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the kitchen in the morning and walks out to the balcony at Jason's house. Follow her, choose Accept, and she shows you how to meditate. That meditation is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends, and PowerPyx reports it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy - do it to be safe. The last spot cannot be done until you can play as both characters, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.

sources.name: KeenGamer - GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His questline is Jason only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts you - meet him in Lummox County for the quest Veteran Hunted. He then marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he requests and bring them back to him. In his first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal unlocks the trophy, so finish his whole questline rather than hunting one animal. All 15 of his Target Decks are also needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. PowerPyx lists all 18 card set locations, so pick the three easiest sets to finish first. The 100% checklist wants all 15 sets, so keep collecting after this pops - the cards you already found carry over.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app: hold Up, then R1, while looking at a scannable object. The locations break down as 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher Tags - any 100 count, and there are more than 100 in total, so just scan whatever you pass while playing.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges - eight groups of ten, tracked under Progress, then Challenges. The 100% checklist needs any 70 of 80, so this trophy pops on the way there; there are 10 more challenges than the checklist needs, so you can skip the hardest ones and pick the quickest. Many complete naturally while you work on the other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape the heat. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as both characters and call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause carnage until you hit 4 stars, then get out of the red heat zone - PowerPyx recommends driving through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally during bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. You need both characters, so this only works after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets in a row - the green icons on the map - while staying wanted the whole time. Keep the flashing red and blue wanted level, not the red heat level, and loot a couple of items plus the safe in each shop. The pop is delayed about half a minute after leaving the third shop, and if it does not pop, rob a fourth. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it - scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan the traffic going past. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted, but it only lasts a few seconds and drains the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food, drinks or Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor from an Ammu-Nation, and use an accurate full-auto rifle such as the Duke 556. Line up 5 gang members at a Gang Operation - soldiers, police and civilians do not seem to count. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the airport: steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal - not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge to get inside. Go upstairs to the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip, take off and fly about 1 km away from the airport - the pop is slightly delayed.

sources.name: eGamers - GTA 6 Trophy List (steal a docked jet, fly about 1 km)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank. The Rhinos stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive in through the gate or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and shoot some enemies until the trophy pops.

sources.name: eGamers - GTA 6 Trophy List (steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 - that unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors, and unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with green icons on the map. Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun, never kick the door, then find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, and destroy the security footage and disable the alarm before you leave. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out. Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while the vault is open and rob it - bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone, and hand off a bag by holding Right. After that quest you can buy security-van tips from Yasmani for $10,000 each; he marks the vans with purple icons. Every vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to become unrecognizable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. It pops automatically in the same Chapter 4 mission, That's Where The Money Is, that unlocks bank vault robberies - robbing the vault counts as robbing an armored truck. To get it earlier, block an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: fully unfog the whole map. The fastest way is by plane - fly over every patch of black fog until the entire map is visible. PowerPyx's unfog guide names the best plane for the job. You will clear most of it naturally while travelling for other trophies.

sources.name: eGamers - GTA 6 Trophy List (clear the fog; flying is quickest)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs - one per gang is enough for the trophy. There are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you go near them, and the 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way. Track how many operations you have robbed per gang under Progress, then Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. PowerPyx's method: go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, buy an Apple Martini and drink it while standing next to the bar. Note that eGamers still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so if the bar does not pop it, try the other rooftop bars on Ocean Beach - the location and the drink are the reported facts.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. PowerPyx's method: steal the blue Banshee from the showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the window. You need the Key Cloner first, from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, and only that blue Banshee counts - no other car works. The pop is slightly delayed, so drive on down the street after smashing out. Note that eGamers still lists the steps as unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley: steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the Gang Operations. Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first - you need them to blow the safe. Inside, pick up the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, and if you miss an item the robbery icon respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Build strength by working out - buy a fitness club membership and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle), because while one character works out the other trains automatically, so you make double progress. Filter the map by Activities to find fitness clubs, and check strength under Touchpad, then Jason and Lucia, then Strength. You can also work out at home after the story.

sources.name: eGamers - GTA 6 Trophy List (max out Strength for both characters)

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your Criminal Profile. Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list, and turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, so a small demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. Stealthy objectives, clean escapes, incapacitating enemies without killing them and outright violence all count, so it builds passively through robberies and fights. If it is still missing at the end, it farms quickly - but avoid the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Still unconfirmed at the time of writing, so do not grind blindly for this one. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue - possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; the store is in Little Cuba, Vice City. No guide has confirmed a method yet, and eGamers lists it as unconfirmed too. Check back here: this entry is updated when a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Complete the UFO easter egg. At night after 2AM, go alone to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County. If a blinking car is parked at the roadside, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO as a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted - talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside; do that and the trophy pops. The spawn is slightly random: if the car is not there, drive away and come back.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it in a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are packed together. PowerPyx reports this method; eGamers still lists the exact steps as unconfirmed, so if it does not pop, keep the kicks inside one minute and stay on the bike.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. First finish Credit Check in Chapter 3, where you meet Raul's crew - that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The total is cumulative across all robberies, so you do not need $250,000 at once, and bank vaults alone pay up to $205,000 each once they unlock in Chapter 4. It comes naturally while you do the robberies for 100%.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops, cumulatively - every shop type counts. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there because they are the most expensive things you can buy. You will spend much of this naturally on weapons, armor and vehicle upgrades while playing.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garages - the 4 story garages do not count. They cost $160,000 in total and are bought through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, which appears after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses. Robberies are the quickest way to fund them, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses. You need enough garages first - see Little Boxes - because each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
